construction.long_horizon: if T>=ceil(m_star), drift the threshold during the final ceil(m_star) steps by L/ceil(m_star)<=Delta/q per step
construction.short_horizon: if T<ceil(m_star), use the final target statically for all T steps
construction.marginal: sample I uniform in [d], G uniform in (0,1), X=G e_I
construction.target: h_Z(G e_i)=+1 iff Z_i=1 and G>=1-L_t; labels pass through eta-RCN

halfspace_realizability.basis: h_Z(x)=sign(sum_i Z_i x_i-(1-L_t)) on the support {G e_i}

rcn_contract.basis: each target label is independently flipped with eta=(1-q)/2

tv_drift.basis: target disagreement per step <=Delta/q and an RCN label channel contracts it by q, hence joint TV<=Delta

information_budget.basis: BSC capacity C(q)<=q^2 and sum_t L_t q^2 <=2*Delta*q*m_star^2=d/3200<d/1600

probability_quantifier.basis: generalized Fano with the Hamming ball of radius d/4 gives average success <1/2 for d>=40; therefore some Z has success <1/2

risk_reduction.basis: a wrong majority bit forces disagreement on at least half its active interval; d/4 wrong bits imply RCN excess >=Delta*m_star/8

all_horizons.basis: the drifting construction covers T>=ceil(m_star); the static construction covers shorter T with no larger information budget

observations.source_deviation: The construction removes the extra d from the source threshold. This is an independent repair, not validation of the printed proof.
observations.asymptotic_scope: The little-o statement is interpreted over d>=40 with d*Delta/q^3 -> 0; fixed finitely many smaller dimensions do not alter the asymptotic lower bound.
